submitted.rationale: With 2.1 eV illumination, only Fe-rich films are expected to absorb well enough to respond. The 1:1 and Sb-rich films (indices 12 and 20) gave EQE of about zero or slightly negative, around -0.0003%. The most Fe-rich film, index 0 (Fe 0.81), gave the best result: 0.0057% EQE. XRD shows the same main peaks from index 4 through index 12. A new peak near Q≈1.9 appears only at the Sb-rich end (indices 20 and 27), which fits the loss of activity there.
